description: This file defines the interface `FinancialActivityAccountReadPlatformService`, which declares methods for retrieving financial activity account data, adding template details, and obtaining templates within the accounting financial activity account service.

classes.name: FinancialActivityAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for accessing financial activity account data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all financial activity account data.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves financial activity account data for a given mapping ID.

methods.name: addTemplateDetails
methods.description: Adds template details to the provided financial activity account data.

methods.name: getFinancialActivityAccountTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for financial activity account data.
